item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President assigns agency heads, interagency bodies, CISSO, and the Executive Agent mandatory internal-management duties involving staffing, program implementation, assessment, coordination, policy development, and reporting; these provisions organize executive operations rather than themselves changing legal rights or dictating a specified later legal consequence.","evidence":"There is established a Senior Information Sharing and Safeguarding Steering Committee"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The provision presently establishes and staffs an interagency task force and directs it to develop an executive-branch program and policies; these are internal organizational and policy-development functions, with no substantive legal consequence imposed by this segment.","evidence":"There is established an interagency Insider Threat Task Force"},{"segment_id":"3","code":2,"rationale":"The Task Force must develop and, within one year, issue minimum standards and guidance that will become binding on the executive branch upon that later issuance, so the segment dictates a legally consequential agency outcome to be produced later.","evidence":"issuing those minimum standards and guidance, which shall be binding on the executive branch"}]}
